finalText:
Build is clean now (exit 0). Two real bugs from the bump, both in the link stage — the rest was just deprecation noise from the version jump:

1. **`src/core/options.js`** — the bundler's options shape changed from `{ retries }` to `{ retryCount }`; this call site still read `options.retries`, which was `undefined`, so `.toFixed(0)` threw. Fixed to read `options.retryCount`.
2. **`src/net/retryPolicy.js`** — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, but `isBackoffEnabled` only handled explicit `true`/`false` and threw on anything else. Added an `undefined` → `false` (disabled) case.

The remaining 8 warnings are genuine deprecation notices (`Buffer()`, `fs.exists`, sync loader hooks, etc.) — real console noise, not build-breaking, so I left those as-is unless you want them cleaned up too.
